last_seen_at.description: Last observed activity on the Peer connection. While the Peer is online this advances with packet and service-stream traffic; while it is offline this is the activity recorded when the connection went down. It is the zero time only when the Server has never observed the Peer.

debug_mode.description: Device-owned debug access mode: off (default), readonly, or fullcontrol. Stored by the authoritative Server and set through authenticated server.runtime.put.
